sloka: वज्रप्रहारानचला यथा घोरान्विषेहिरे ।गदाप्रहारांस्तौ तत्र सेहाते नरराक्षसौ ।। ७.३२.५४ ॥
transliteration: vajraprahārānacalā yathā ghorānviṣehire ।gadāprahārāṁstau tatra sehāte nararākṣasau ।। 7.32.54 ॥

translations.english: Just as mountains endure terrible thunderbolt strikes, so too did the man (Arjuna) and the demon (Ravana) endure each other's mace strikes in that battle.
